question: Does reducing K lower search cost without losing target attainment?

scopes.work: Total kernel iterations per trajectory, construction plus local search; 128 trajectories per run.
scopes.checkpoint: Only actual nominal observations. No missing observation is interpolated or carried forward.
scopes.denominator: Ten observed runs for each method at every displayed work checkpoint; all other denominators retained.
scopes.display_crop: Step zero is excluded from logarithmic axes; positive work checkpoints stop at first both-method 10/10 target attainment.
scopes.time: Empirical CDF of first target detection at a completed batch, not a reconstructed objective-progress curve.
scopes.targets: Frozen own reference values, not claims of optimality; published values and aliases retained in source data.
scopes.cost: 512-step counters aggregate all 128 trajectories. CUDA kernel and host wall clocks are distinct and not added.
